inputs.commit_message: verify ASOL release and security gates on repair branch
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/hesham/gova
branch=agent-request/chatgpt
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/asol-stage3-proof-XXXXXX)
cleanup() { git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -rf "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$root" fetch origin "$branch"
remote_sha=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse "origin/$branch")
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$tmp" "$remote_sha"
cd "$tmp"
rm -rf .agent-control/requests
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run services:sync
npm run docs:generate
npm run docs:ci
npm run runtime:check
npm run architecture:check
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm run validate:error-logging
npm run test:api-core
npm run test:gova-deployment-core
npm run verify:all
rm -rf .tmp-gova-build
npm run gova:tree
(cd .tmp-gova-build && ASOL_RUNTIME_ROLE=gova-frontend node ../node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build)
(cd .tmp-gova-build && npm run gova:artifact:verify)
npm run control:verify
npm run control:build
npm run control:smoke
echo ASOL_RELEASE_GATES=PASS
echo ASOL_SECURITY_ADVERSARIAL=PASS
echo ASOL_STAGE3_SHA=$remote_sha
